en.headline: Golden Week day three passes 1.02 million crossings by 9pm
en.dek: The Immigration Department said more than 1.02 million people had crossed Hong Kong's control points by 9pm on Saturday, the third day of the mainland holiday.
body: Hong Kong logged more than 1.02 million arrivals and departures by 9pm on Saturday, the Immigration Department said, as the third day of the mainland National Day Golden Week continued to move large numbers through the control points.

Nearly 466,000 of those crossings were inbound. Mainland visitors accounted for more than 210,000 of the arrivals, with the largest share coming through the Lok Ma Chau Spur Line control point, followed by the West Kowloon high-speed rail station.

Outbound traffic was higher still, at more than 536,000 crossings. Hong Kong residents made up about 340,000 of the departures. The department said the busiest exit for residents was Lo Wu, then the Lok Ma Chau Spur Line.

The evening tally is well above the figure the department gave at 4pm the same day, when crossings had already passed 638,000. Officials had earlier expected Saturday to be the land-border departure peak of the holiday and Sunday the arrival peak.

zh.headline: 黃金周第三天截至晚上9時逾102萬人次出入境
zh.dek: 入境處表示，周六晚上9時，本港各管制站累計出入境已超過102萬人次，為內地國慶黃金周第三天。
body: 入境處表示，內地國慶黃金周第三天，截至周六晚上9時，經本港各管制站出入境的人次已超過102萬。
當中入境近46萬6千人次，內地旅客超過21萬人次。入境處指，內地旅客最多經落馬洲支線管制站入境，其次是西九龍高鐵站。
出境則超過53萬6千人次，本港居民約佔34萬人次。港人出境最多經羅湖口岸，其次是落馬洲支線管制站。
晚上的數字遠高於同日下午4時的逾63萬8千人次。入境處早前估計，周六是陸路出境高峰，周日則是入境高峰。
